name: Altair Health
long_description:
Altair is an AI-native medical billing service for independent practices. We take over a practice's billing end to end and get doctors paid by insurers. AI does the work; our billers handle the exceptions.

That can only work if a practice can trust an agent alone with its revenue. So we formalized insurers' billing policies and put a theorem prover under the agent. Before the agent acts on a claim, the prover checks the action against that insurer's policies, and anything that fails goes to one of our billers. 

Every claim teaches Altair how each insurer behaves, so the longer we run a practice's billing, the better we predict what its insurers will pay, deny or delay.

We're building the default way a new practice gets paid: a doctor connects their EHR and bills clean, completely self-serve and on auto-pilot.

Altair will be the financial platform every independent practice in America starts on and stays on. And to the Health Insurers' "Delay, Deny, Defend", we say "Predict, Prevent, Prevail".

launches.title: Altair Health - We get doctors paid on autopilot
launches.body:
Hey everyone! We're Aouss and Jad, the founders of Altair Health (YC F26).

**TL;DR:** Altair uses AI to run a practice's billing end to end and fights insurers until the doctor gets paid. Our first clinic recovered $60K in unpaid claims within two weeks, and its collection rate went from 85% to 98% in the first month.

<https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=WKCUFGMPZfM>

❌ **The problem**

Doctors in the US have to chase insurers to get paid for care they've already delivered. Insurers deny valid claims, change the rules halfway through, and wait to see who fights back. If the doctor appeals and wins, the money shows up months later. If the doctor gives up, the insurer keeps it.

Many practices run on a few weeks of cash, so months of delay can shut them down. The ones that survive play it safe. We've talked to dozens of doctors who won't add a new service because they can't tell from a 40-page policy whether the insurer will pay for it, so their patients go without that care.

✅ **Our solution**

We take over a practice's billing, from eligibility checks and coding to claims, payment posting and appeals. AI does the repetitive work, so we can afford to chase the $20 claims other billing teams write off. Our billers step in on the claims that need a human. We charge a percentage over the revenue we manage to collect from insurers. 

**Doctors see where their money is.** They can follow each claim and payment down to the dollar. If a deposit comes in short, they can see which claims it covers and which ones we're still fighting.

**Every denial makes the next claim harder to deny.** Before a claim goes out, we check it against that insurer's own written policies. If the insurer denies a claim that followed those policies, we appeal it and work out what changed. Then we update our checks for every clinic we work with, so the longer we run a practice's billing, the better we can predict which claims each insurer will pay and which it will fight.

📈 **Results so far**

Our first client is Little Rock Recovery, an addiction treatment center in Arkansas. You'll meet Michael and Anthony in the video. Before Altair, they were losing about $100K every six months in money they were owed. Two weeks in, we had recovered $60K. A month in, their collection rate had gone from 85% to 98%.

We’re currently onboarding a Spravato clinic that makes $10M a year and our onboarding schedule is full until February.

🔭 **Our vision**

Getting paid by a health insurer should be as simple as taking a card payment. We're building that for every doctor in America, so they can spend their time on patients and offer new services without betting the practice on an insurer's response. 

The Stripe of Medical Billing. 

🙏 **Our ask**

If you run a practice, or know a doctor who's tired of chasing insurers, we'd love to hear from you at [aouss@altair-health.com](mailto:aouss@altair-health.com).

Aouss and Jad
